experiencePage.title: A career across science, software and project leadership
introduction: My career has developed around projects that required an understanding of several disciplines, organised collective work and direct contributions to the solution.

Following training in physics, chemistry and biophysics, I led experimental research projects, built scientific instruments and software, and later managed the development of a digital platform combining AI and XR.

journey.title: Science and teaching
journey.description: Training in physics, chemistry, materials and nanoscience, complemented by a French national teaching qualification and several teaching roles.

journey.title: Biophysics and research
journey.description: A PhD on lipid membranes and peptides, followed by research involving molecular simulation and machine learning.

journey.title: Instrumentation and complex systems
journey.description: Leadership of iSCAT platforms, creation of a molecular-communication laboratory and development of automated instruments.

journey.title: Digital products, AI and XR
journey.description: Leadership of a virtual campus combining a web platform, educational tools, generative artificial intelligence and immersive applications.

journey.title: Current positioning
journey.description: An R&D Project Manager able to coordinate specialist teams while contributing directly to selected technical developments.

mainExperiences.summary: Led the creation of a virtual campus for a French digital apprenticeship training centre, combining a web platform, educational tools, generative artificial intelligence and XR.
highlights: Defined objectives, scope, technical and material resources, organisation and roadmap.
Coordinated an average multidisciplinary team of eleven people through direct and matrix management.
Gathered requirements, wrote functional and technical specifications and validated deliverables with the client.
Contributed directly to the TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB backend and selected React interfaces.
Designed the architecture and integration protocols for several generative-AI providers.
Led prompt engineering and coordinated production of four XR applications.

mainExperiences.organisation: King’s College London — Department of Engineering
mainExperiences.summary: Created a molecular-communication laboratory and developed an experimental testbed combining chemistry, microfluidics, instrumentation, electronics and signal processing.
highlights: Created the laboratory, prepared the premises, selected equipment and established safety and operating protocols.
Led an average team of five and trained nine users in total.
Managed two EPSRC grants totalling €360,000.
Developed a one-dimensional CNN to analyse UV-Visible signals and estimate the composition of aqueous solutions.
Designed and manufactured six open-source syringe pumps.
Produced work published in Nature Communications and IEEE T-MBMC.

mainExperiences.summary: Led a research project funded by the BBSRC and co-funded by Oxford Nanopore Technologies to build and operate an iSCAT microscope.
highlights: Led a €500,000 project.
Managed three PhD researchers and two Master’s interns.
Built the microscope from component procurement through optical-table assembly and qualification.
Developed LabVIEW control and automation software.
Designed most of the experimental chain, including protocols, samples, acquisition, image analysis and result analysis.
Delivered a complete operational microscope.

mainExperiences.summary: Provided scientific and operational direction for work involving lipid membranes, molecular simulation and machine learning.
highlights: Planned methods, milestones and scientific direction.
Ran molecular-dynamics simulations using GROMACS.
Developed machine-learning approaches followed by a three-dimensional CNN using TensorFlow.
Led development of the open-source MLLPA Python module.
Created the complete MLLPA website and documentation.

lxp-campus.title: Virtual LXP campus integrating AI and XR
lxp-campus.context: Creation of a virtual campus for a French digital apprenticeship training centre delivering professional qualifications at levels 3 to 6.
lxp-campus.role: Product Manager responsible for project leadership, with direct contributions to the backend, selected interfaces and artificial-intelligence integration.
lxp-campus.summary: The project combined learning content, employment support, health and disability services, generative artificial intelligence and XR applications.
highlights: Scoped the needs, project boundaries, resources and roadmap.
Coordinated an average multidisciplinary team of eleven people through direct and matrix management.
Wrote specifications and validated solutions with the client.
Developed parts of the TypeScript, Node.js, Express and MongoDB backend.
Designed the multi-provider generative-AI architecture and processing queue.
Led prompt engineering and coordinated production of four XR applications.
lxp-campus.status: When the contract ended, the backend and AI ecosystem were operational, all four XR applications were complete and the interface remained partially unfinished.
lxp-campus.confidentiality: The client is anonymised. No confidential interface or project material should be published without approval.

mllpa-project.title: MLLPA — Machine Learning-assisted Lipid Phase Analysis
mllpa-project.context: Work initiated at the University of Strasbourg to analyse lipid-membrane phases from molecular-dynamics simulations.
mllpa-project.role: Scientific lead for the initial project and principal developer of the Python module, website and documentation.
mllpa-project.summary: MLLPA turns a research method into a documented and reusable Python tool for analysing membrane systems.
highlights: Developed approximately 95% of the Python module code.
Created the complete website and documentation.
Used NumPy, h5py, MDAnalysis, pandas and scikit-learn.
Developed machine-learning approaches and a three-dimensional CNN using TensorFlow.
Published several first-author papers.
mllpa-project.status: The open-source software is published, with related research continuing occasionally.

Wrote the technical specifications.
Developed, integrated and deployed the LabVIEW software.
Produced documentation and trained users.
The prototype was reproduced on two additional microscopes.
medical-microscope.status: The prototype was deployed and later reproduced on two additional instruments.
medical-microscope.confidentiality: The sample type and precise medical purpose are covered by NDA.
